facts.fact: INSTAD and stakeholders validated the draft third national statistics development strategy SNDS 3 (2025-2029) at a workshop held the day before publication, with formal adoption stated to be expected in the coming weeks; the work was financed with the World Bank.

note: Regional strategy RSDS II 2026-2030 adopted; states nothing of this country's national strategy.

facts.fact: PARIS21's January 2026 NSDS status table lists the strategy as implementing (adopted): SNDS 2025-2029.

note: SPI 5.5.1 is a bare finance score that names no strategy, so it states nothing one of the aspects can hold.

claims.spi-014b72c84e: nothing: a bare score, names no strategy

facts.fact: La Nation reports INSTAD launched with partners a workshop opening the elaboration of the third national statistics development strategy (SNDS-3) for 2025-2029, the earlier strategies being of 2011 and 2018.

note: Evaluation reported is of the 2011 and 2018 strategies, not the current one.

facts.fact: PARIS21's September 2024 table lists its strategy as in implementation (NSDS 2018-2022), continued after expiration.
The sixth CPSM of 25 September 2024 presented the roadmap for formulating the third SNDS, after the SNDS 2018-2022, says La Nation.
INSTAD's director announced the launch of work to formulate the third national statistics development strategy (SNDS3), to be launched officially at the CPSM of 25 September 2024.
